board.name: Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education (HPBOSE), Dharamshala
board.summary: The Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education, at Gyan Alok Parisar in Dharamshala (Kangra), has worked since 1969. It conducts the Matric (Class 10) and Plus Two (Class 12) examinations, runs the state open school (SOS) examinations, and holds a Teacher Eligibility Test. Its site lists syllabi, model papers, a competency-based question bank for Matric, OMR specimens and step-wise marking instructions, along with date sheets, results and re-evaluation notices.

intro: Himachal Pradesh has no NXTutors city tuition-jobs page yet, so tutors in Shimla, Dharamshala, Mandi, Solan, Kullu and the state's other towns all begin here. Write your town and the localities you are willing to visit. A home request is offered first to the nearest suitable tutors and then further out, so being specific helps a family close to you find your profile. Online lessons are matched by subject, class and board, not location, which lets a tutor in Chamba or Hamirpur teach a student in any state. Una, Solan and Palampur tutors join the same way.

Himachal students may sit the Matric and Plus Two through HPBOSE or follow CBSE, ICSE or another board, in Hindi or English medium. List each board and medium you teach. HPBOSE's competency-based question bank for Matric, its model papers and step-wise marking instructions are on hpbose.org, and reading them before a demo is sensible. For every request, two or three tutors are shortlisted; the family sees your fee before a free first class and can switch later at no cost. If you help Plus Two students with a particular stream, such as science or commerce, name it.

faqs: Does HPBOSE publish a question bank?
Yes. Its site lists a competency-based question bank for Matric, model papers and step-wise marking instructions. These are useful to read before a demo with a Matric or Plus Two student.
Can I teach online from a hill town?
Yes. Online lessons are matched by subject, class and board, so a tutor in Kullu, Chamba or Nahan can be shortlisted for students anywhere. Home lessons go to the nearest suitable tutors first.
NXTutors picks two or three for each request, nearest first, then wider and online. The family sees each fee, books a free first class, and may switch later without paying for the switch.
What is verified when I join?
Your phone or email through a one-time code, and a government photo ID that the team reviews before your profile goes live. It is an ID check, not a police check. See How we verify tutors.
On /pricing. Tutor plans are paid, and the page lists what each includes. You choose your own lesson fee.
